title: KGCS Agent Response Envelope
description: Canonical response envelope for all KGCS agent responses. All three specialist agents and the orchestrator return payloads conforming to this schema.

version.description: Schema version. Version bump required for breaking changes to the envelope.

correlation_id.description: UUID propagated end-to-end for audit and tracing.

status.description: ok: data returned; empty: valid query but no rows; error: non-recoverable failure.

data.description: Agent-specific payload. Validated separately against the per-agent response schema (systems-response.json, offensive-response.json, defensive-response.json).

provenance.description: Source attribution for all data in this response. Required to have at least one entry when status is 'ok'.

source.description: Authoritative data source name, e.g. 'NVD', 'MITRE ATT&CK', 'MITRE CAPEC'.

ids.description: Canonical IDs from the source that contributed to this response.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the source record at time of ingestion.

confidence.description: Confidence computation per the confidence-model spec maintained in kgcs-server.

value.description: Scalar confidence 0–1. Computed per confidence model spec.

basis.description: Basis for the confidence value. COMPLETE_CHAIN = full causal path traversed.

signals.description: Raw signals used to compute confidence.value.

rows.description: Number of result rows returned by the Cypher template.

hops.description: Number of causal chain hops traversed (max 6 for full chain).

shape_validated.description: Whether the query result was cross-checked against SHACL shapes.

freshness_days.description: Days since the most recently modified source record. Values > 365 trigger a 0.1 confidence penalty.

degradation.description: Ordered list of applied confidence penalties, e.g. ['missing_hop:capec', 'stale_data'].

errors.description: Present (and non-empty) when status is 'error'. Contains human-readable error messages.

CausedByEdgeProperties.$comment: v1.1 (kgcs-spec 1.1.0, ADR-0002). Graph-layer properties of the (Vulnerability)-[:CAUSED_BY]->(Weakness) edge; exactly one edge per (CVE, CWE) pair. Not part of the response envelope: referenced by per-agent response schemas and loader tests. The three lists are index-aligned and of equal length; Draft-07 cannot express equal length, which is enforced by shapes/cve.shacl.ttl (cve:CausedByStatementShape) and the pipeline post-load check.

sources.description: Raw NVD weaknesses[].source identifiers, verbatim (e.g. nvd@nist.gov, or the CNA's e-mail/UUID). Document order.

sourceRoles.description: Aligned with sources: 'nvd' for nvd@nist.gov, 'adp' for a declared Authorized Data Publisher identifier (today only 134c704f-9b21-4f2e-91b3-4a467353bcc0, CISA ADP), 'cna' for any other assigning source.

KevEntryProperties.$comment: v1.2 (kgcs-spec 1.2.0, ADR-0003). Graph-layer properties of a KevEntry node (CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog entry), adhered to exactly one Vulnerability by HAS_KEV_ENTRY; exactly one KevEntry per CVE. Not part of the response envelope: referenced by per-agent response schemas and loader tests. Dates are ISO strings as CISA publishes them.

cveId.description: KEV cveID, verbatim (CISA pattern). Unique on the KevEntry label.

dateAdded.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the date the CVE entered the catalog.

dueDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the date the required action is due.

forensicTriage.description: Whether BOD 26-04 requires forensic triage (CISA field added in 2026).

cwes.description: KEV cwes[], verbatim strings. Never materialised as CAUSED_BY edges (ADR-0003).

catalogVersion.description: Top-level catalogVersion of the catalog file the entry was loaded from, e.g. 2026.09.25.

dateReleased.description: Top-level dateReleased of that catalog file.

examples.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
examples.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request.
examples.requiredAction: Apply vendor mitigations per BOD 26-04 guidance

EpssScoreProperties.$comment: v1.2 (kgcs-spec 1.2.0, ADR-0003). Graph-layer properties of an EpssScore node (one FIRST EPSS daily CSV row), adhered to exactly one Vulnerability by HAS_EPSS; one node per CVE per scoreDate, never overwritten. A published datum: agents report it with scoreDate and modelVersion and never compute with it; it is not an input to confidence.

score.description: CSV column epss, verbatim precision (5 decimals).

scoreDate.description: Date part of the CSV header score_date (= the file date).

modelVersion.description: CSV header model_version, e.g. v2026.06.15. Scores from different model versions are not comparable.

SsvcDecisionProperties.$comment: v1.2 (kgcs-spec 1.2.0, ADR-0003). Graph-layer properties of an SsvcDecision node (one NVD metrics.ssvcV203[] entry by a declared ADP), adhered to exactly one Vulnerability by HAS_SSVC; one node per CVE per ADP timestamp.

version.description: ssvcData.version; the only value NVD publishes under ssvcV203.

timestamp.description: ssvcData.timestamp, verbatim (two lexical forms occur in NVD).

source.description: NVD source identifier of the publisher, verbatim (CISA ADP: 134c704f-9b21-4f2e-91b3-4a467353bcc0).

sourceRole.description: ADR-0002 role of source; v1.2 admits declared ADPs only.

AtlasTacticProperties.$comment: v1.2 (kgcs-spec 1.2.0, ADR-0004). Graph-layer properties of an AtlasTactic node (MITRE ATLAS tactic). ATLAS is a parallel matrix beside ATT&CK, not a hop of the causal chain.

atlasId.description: Source id. Unique on the label.

name.description: Source name, verbatim. Not unique; never a key.

matrixPosition.description: position of the ATLAS-matrix sequences relationship (column in the matrix).

examples.name: Lateral Movement
examples.description: The adversary is trying to move through your AI environment.

AtlasTechniqueProperties.$comment: v1.2 (kgcs-spec 1.2.0, ADR-0004). Graph-layer properties of an AtlasTechnique (atlasId AML.T####) or AtlasSubTechnique (AML.T####.###) node. Not an ATT&CK Technique.

atlasId.description: Source id; AML.T#### on AtlasTechnique, AML.T####.### on AtlasSubTechnique. Unique on each label.

name.description: Source name, verbatim. Not unique; never a key.

examples.name: Use Alternate Authentication Material
examples.description: Adversaries may use alternate authentication material to move laterally within an AI environment.

AtlasMitigationProperties.$comment: v1.2 (kgcs-spec 1.2.0, ADR-0004). Graph-layer properties of an AtlasMitigation node. ATLAS mitigations MITIGATE ATLAS techniques only; not a D3FEND DefensiveTechnique.

atlasId.description: Source id. Unique on the label.

name.description: Source name, verbatim. Not unique; never a key.

examples.name: Control Access to AI Models and Data in Production
examples.description: Require users to verify their identities before accessing a production model.

AdaptedFromEdgeProperties.$comment: v1.2 (kgcs-spec 1.2.0, ADR-0004). Graph-layer properties of the (AtlasTechnique|AtlasSubTechnique)-[:ADAPTED_FROM]->(Technique|SubTechnique) edge: the provenance of the only edge between ATLAS and another standard. Written only where the ATLAS object carries attack-reference.

sourceField.description: ATLAS field that declares the adaptation.

attackReferenceId.description: attack-reference.id, verbatim. Equals the target's attackId unless a revoked target was remapped.
